title: Taco Dip
description: A creamy, cheesy taco dip with seasoned ground beef, Fiesta Ranch, and Rotel. Serve chilled with tortilla chips.

ingredients.name: Rotel diced tomatoes and green chilies

steps: Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium heat, seasoning with salt and black pepper to taste. Drain excess grease.
In a large bowl, combine sour cream, Fiesta Ranch seasoning mix, Rotel, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Add the cooked ground beef and mix until everything is evenly combined.
Refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve chilled with tortilla chips.

title: Baked Bacon Mac & Cheese
description: Extra-creamy baked cheddar mac and cheese with a full pound of bacon, a silky sodium-citrate cheese sauce, and a golden cheesy topping.

ingredients.name: shredded cheddar cheese, divided (1 lb for sauce; ½ lb for topping)
heavy cream, as needed for sauce consistency

steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Cook the elbow pasta in salted water until about 2–3 minutes shy of fully cooked; drain.
In a saucepan, bring the chicken broth to a low simmer. Stir in the sodium citrate, then gradually add 1 lb of the shredded cheddar, stirring until melted and smooth.

Gradually add 1–2 cups of heavy cream to moderate the temperature and thin the sauce. Stir in 2 tablespoons of reserved bacon grease and all 3 tablespoons of butter. Aim for a sauce slightly thinner than nacho cheese; it will thicken in the oven.
Combine the pasta, cheese sauce, and chopped cooked bacon. Fold gently and season to taste with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Transfer to a casserole dish and top with the remaining ½ lb of shredded cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for about 45 minutes, until heated through and bubbly.

title: Homemade Hollandaise Sauce
description: A rich, buttery, lemony hollandaise made gently in one saucepan with constant stirring.
steps: Add the butter chunks, water, lemon juice, and egg yolks to a saucepan.
Heat over very low heat, stirring constantly as the butter melts and the sauce comes together.
Remove the pan from the heat as needed to keep it from overheating or scrambling the eggs. Continue stirring until the sauce is smooth and slightly thickened.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Serve promptly.
